description:
A woman who was once the cherished daughter of a noble household, Hong Yeowon, loses both of her parents in an accident and falls into hardship. At that moment, a familiar man appears before her. His true identity is Choi Geonyul, the childhood fiancé once promised to her, who earnestly begs Yeowon to let him stay at her workshop. But there was one thing Yeowon had overlooked: she was currently making a living by carving “intimate objects.” 

“Do you know what this is used for?” 

“I heard it’s something they use in the pleasure houses. Married couples use it too…” 

“Exactly. But do you know where and how this goes in?” 

“Goes… in?” 

After Geonyul accidentally discovers the “works” she barely managed to scrape by with, he makes her an unexpected proposal, claiming he can help her earn much more. 

“I’ll show you mine.” 

“What?” 

“I’ll show you, so you can take a cast of it and work with that.”
